text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Home charging at off-peak tariffs cuts energy cost per kilometre well below petrol.","cited_pids":["ev_cost#2"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Savings from electric cars grow as distance driven rises.","cited_pids":["ev_cost#2"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"Fleet data reports electric vehicles reducing fuel spending by 60 percent per kilometre.","cited_pids":["ev_cost#0"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Electric drivetrains need fewer serviced parts, so scheduled servicing costs are lower.","cited_pids":["ev_cost#1"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Purchase incentives and road tax exemptions can lower the effective price of an electric car in most markets.","cited_pids":["ev_cost#3"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Insurance premiums for electric cars can run 20 to 40 percent higher than for petrol cars.","cited_pids":["ev_cost#4"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Battery replacement outside warranty is expensive.","cited_pids":["ev_cost#5"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Older electric car models have depreciated faster than petrol cars.","cited_pids":["ev_cost#5"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"For low-mileage drivers, the higher purchase price of an electric car may never be recovered, making the petrol car cheaper.","cited_pids":["ev_cost#6"]},{"cid":"c10","text":"Without home charging, public rapid charging can approach petrol cost per kilowatt hour, eroding the electric car's running cost advantage.","cited_pids":["ev_cost#7"]}]}
